page: Microsoft Azure DC8eds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the DCEDV6 family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration includes 472 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance, and it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and local NVMe SSD storage provide a balanced resource density for workloads requiring consistent compute performance and fast local read/write capabilities. The hardware profile is designed for memory-optimized tasks, database hosting, and general-purpose enterprise applications that benefit from dedicated virtualization resources without GPU acceleration.
